content.text:
The page was already well built, so I made two small changes to `0.html` instead of rewriting it. I haven't opened it in a browser to check.

1. **Colours now work in older browsers.** The colours used `light-dark()`, which Safari only supports from 17.5 and Chrome from 123. In older versions every colour variable was invalid, so the page lost its text, background, accent and border colours. I switched to plain colour values with a dark-mode override, which works everywhere and looks the same in current browsers.
2. **Added the "smooth interactions" the page mentions.** Link underlines and the skip link now animate briefly on hover and focus. The animation is turned off for people who have "reduce motion" enabled.

One thing for you to decide: line 10 puts your email address (`ksmith@centricle.com`) in the `author` meta tag. That makes it public and easy for spam bots to scrape. You may want to use a name there instead.
